stem: A lighting recommendation lists fixture wattage and photoperiod but no canopy PPFD measurements. What is the most important limitation when evaluating its DLI claim?
choices: Wattage does not directly establish photon flux reaching the canopy
Photoperiod has no effect on DLI
Fixture brand determines DLI more accurately than PPFD
DLI can only be measured outdoors
rationale: Electrical wattage alone does not state how many photosynthetic photons reach the canopy. A defensible DLI estimate requires PPFD at the canopy plus photoperiod.
